display_long_description:
Feel the redline. Master the shift. Dominate the strip. This is Redline Rivals VR drag racing.
Grip the wheel, feel the engine roar, and master the one skill that separates champions from the rest: the perfect shift. Timing is everything — nail every manual gear change at the redline to launch off the line, trigger explosive speed boosts, and leave your rivals in the dust.
This isn't auto-shifting. Every gear is yours to command. Read the rev, feel the moment, shift with precision — one mistake and the race is lost.

# BUILD YOUR DREAM GARAGE
Drive 12+ legendary machines — from classic American muscle and vintage racing icons to modern hyper cars and exotic supercars. Every car looks, sounds, and handles distinctly.

# UPGRADE & TUNE
Build the ultimate drag machine. Upgrade your engine, turbo, transmission, nitro, and weight to boost Speed, Acceleration, Power, Nitro, and Mass — fine-tune every stat for the perfect launch.

# NITRO BOOST
Deploy nitro at the perfect moment for a game-changing burst of raw horsepower down the strip.

# RACE RUTHLESS RIVALS
Battle relentless AI opponents in high-stakes single-player drag races. Stay ahead, hit every shift, and prove you own the strip.

# STUNNING ENVIRONMENTS
Race across a variety of immersive, detailed VR tracks built for pure speed and adrenaline.
Straight-line racing means minimal motion — comfortable for every VR player.
Feel the horsepower. Master the shift. Become a drag racing legend.
Real drag racing. Real adrenaline. Redline Rivals VR.
